text: Yes, tree-cover loss has been detected on the property after 2020. In 2025, a tree-cover loss event of 13.5 hectares (3.91% of the asset) was observed. This event is corroborated by the JRC 2020 reference data, which shows that 98% of the event area was forest in 2020. The baseline date for these observations was December 31, 2020.
